summary: Explicit actual-primary threefold obstruction: generic sections on exceptional surfaces do not imply all-curve-nef divisorial parts.
detailedSummary: On the blowup of a regular threefold origin and two rational exceptional points, I=(z)+m^2 has divisorial part E1+2E2+2E3. Its negative restricts to H-eP-eQ on Bl_2(P^2), with degree -1 on the joining line. The model is proved an actual primary blowup. Every-support domination survives, but the surface nefness inference fails. This is not a CE counterexample.
text:
Precise THREE-dimensional obstruction to the surface competitor method; this is NOT a continuous-envelope counterexample. Support: ENTIRE qualified G331 and own n1 for the finite section/ACTUAL primary presentation argument. Let R=k[x,y,z]_(x,y,z) for ANY field k, m=(x,y,z), and I=(z)+m^2, a proper primary ideal. Blow up the origin, with exceptional E_0=P^2_k. Blow up the two distinct k-rational points P=[1:0:0], Q=[0:1:0] of E_0. Their disjoint point ideals can be blown up at once; equivalently do the two point blowups successively. All charts are regular (ordinary point blowups in regular coordinates). Let Y be the result, E_1 the strict transform of E_0, and E_2,E_3 the new exceptional planes. Then E_1=Bl_(P,Q)(P^2), while E_2,E_3 are disjoint copies of P^2.

This explicit Y is an ACTUAL primary model. Its second-stage negative tautological bundle O(-E_2-E_3) is relatively ample for Y->Bl_m(R); this is the blowup of the disjoint union of the two point ideals, invertible/unit on the complement. The first negative tautological bundle O(-E_0) is ample. The COMPLETE immediately read Stacks29.38.7--8 gives, for an integer a sufficiently large, O(-E_2-E_3-a pullback(E_0)) ample over R. Here pullback(E_0)=E_1+E_2+E_3. Thus E=aE_1+(a+1)E_2+(a+1)E_3 is ACTUAL effective Cartier, full exceptional support, and O(-E) relatively ample. Stacks37.53.6 gives H^0(Y,O)=R. The finite affine-section localization/projective immersion/Rees argument proved in n1 applies verbatim in this dimension to THIS explicit Y: it requires normal target, ample negative exceptional bundle and projectivity, not surface resolution. A finite set of sections of O(-nE) gives a proper primary J and identifies Y with Bl_J(R). This is an explicit construction and no cofinality assertion for arbitrary threefold modifications.

The divisorial part of I on Y is F_I=E_1+2E_2+2E_3. The order at E_0 is one, realized by z. In the x-chart of the first blowup, with v=y/x and w=z/x, I O=x(w,x). At P the regular local parameters are x,v,w. Thus the residual ideal (w,x) has point order one, so the second exceptional order is two. The y-chart gives the identical calculation at Q. The strict E_1 order remains one. All ideal generators are global sections of O(-F_I) by normal height-one intersection, and at the generic point of EACH E_i at least one realizes the minimum and restricts to a nonzero section, exactly as in the surface competitor proof.

Nevertheless A=-F_I fails the mandatory contracted-curve positivity test. On E_1 let H be the pullback of a line in P^2 and e_P,e_Q its two exceptional curves. Restricting divisors gives E_1|_(E_1)=-H-e_P-e_Q, E_2|_(E_1)=e_P and E_3|_(E_1)=e_Q: the strict first divisor is pullback(E_0)-E_2-E_3, and O(E_0)|_(E_0)=O_P2(-1). Hence
O(-F_I)|_(E_1) has class H-e_P-e_Q.
Let L be the strict transform of the line z=0 through P and Q. It is a proper integral contracted curve with class H-e_P-e_Q. The usual point-blowup chart calculation gives H^2=1, H.e_P=H.e_Q=e_P.e_Q=0 and e_P^2=e_Q^2=-1; these are local normal-bundle degrees, with residue degrees one. Therefore deg_L O(-F_I)=1-1-1=-1. Equivalently the nonzero restricted generator z determines an effective divisor whose fixed component is the negative curve L. A nonzero section on the exceptional SURFACE does not imply nonnegative degree on that curve.

On E_2 and E_3 the restrictions of -F_I are O(1), since E_1 restricts to a hyperplane and each new exceptional normal bundle is O(-1). Nonnegativity there cannot repair the degree -1 on L in E_1. Thus positivity was checked on an ACTUAL primary model, and a SPECIFIC actual contracted integral curve violates it; no purely numerical abstract matrix was substituted.

The every-support inequality -v(I)<=f_(-F_I) still holds: the ideal-sheaf inclusion I O_Y subset O(-F_I) pulls to the valuation ring of Frac(R/p) for each support p, with generic centre outside the exceptional fibre, and regular ratios give the inequality even for killed generators. What fails is the subsequent inference that f_(-F_I) is an all-curve-nef geometric-core competitor on Y. In contrast -v(I) has a negative effective relatively ample Cartier presentation on ACTUAL Bl_I(R). The example therefore pinpoints a false step in the surface strategy while preserving the positivity of genuine primary profiles and existing smooth characteristic-zero CE. It gives no failure of CE in any characteristic and no theorem about arbitrary higher-dimensional model cofinality.

The intersection numbers are proved by the explicit blowup geometry, not by a program. Own finite_diagnostics.py only evaluates the recorded integer degree expression and divisor coefficients; it is a diagnostic. Artifacts n4.md, n4.tex and reports/finite-diagnostics.json; rerun python finite_diagnostics.py; python assemble.py; python verify.py.
